title: Google’s Hollywood Licensing Push Highlights an Uneven AI Bargain
dek: Google is reportedly seeking studio licensing deals to train AI models on copyrighted material. The cash may be attractive, but studios face longer-term strategic and economic trade-offs.
socialCaption: Google is reportedly offering Hollywood studios major payments for AI-training rights. The opportunity is real—but so is the risk of trading long-term leverage for short-term licensing revenue.
